# Community

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Community`](gmeow-Community.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Community>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)

A graph-clustering community (Leiden or similar) over extracted-entity descriptions, at a level ([`gmeow:communityLevel`](../properties/gmeow-communityLevel.md)) of the cluster hierarchy. The clustering run is provenance via the EXISTING [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Community`](gmeow-Community.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
